title: BECE Mathematics Geometry & Measurement - Mathematics - Solid Shapes (3D)
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: How many faces does a cube have?
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Calculate the volume of a cuboid with length $5 \text{ cm}$, breadth $3 \text{ cm}$, and height $4 \text{ cm}$.
questions.explain: Volume of cuboid $= L \times B \times H = 5 \times 3 \times 4 = 60 \text{ cm}^3$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which of the following solids has a circular base and a single vertex?
questions.explain: A cone has a circular base and tapers to a single vertex at the top.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The volume of a cube is $27 \text{ cm}^3$. What is the length of one side?
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: A cylinder has a base radius of $7 \text{ cm}$ and a height of $10 \text{ cm}$. Calculate its volume. (Take $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$)
questions.explain: Volume of cylinder $= \pi r^2 h = \frac{22}{7} \times 7^2 \times 10 = 154 \times 10 = 1540 \text{ cm}^3$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: How many edges does a cuboid have?
questions.explain: A cuboid has 12 edges (4 length, 4 breadth, 4 height).
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which solid shape is formed by a net of two circles and one rectangle?
questions.explain: A cylinder's net consists of two circles (bases) and a rectangular sheet (curved surface).
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Calculate the Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cube with side $2 \text{ cm}$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: A triangular prism has a length of $10 \text{ cm}$ and the area of the triangular cross-section is $12 \text{ cm}^2$. What is its volume?
questions.explain: Volume of a prism $= \text{Area of cross-section} \times \text{length} = 12 \times 10 = 120 \text{ cm}^3$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which of the following solids does NOT have flat faces?
questions.explain: A sphere is a curved surface with no flat faces.
questions.subject: Mathematics
